description.title: מטרות שימוש מותרות
description.summary: This table details the permitted uses of the insured vehicle under the policy. It specifies objectives for which the insurance coverage applies, contingent on being noted on the insurance certificate where required.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את מטרות השימוש המותרות ברכב המבוטח במסגרת הפוליסה. הכיסוי הביטוחי חל על מטרות שימוש המפורטות כאן, בתנאי שצוינו במפורש בתעודת הביטוח במידת הצורך. הפוליסה מכסה מטרות חברתיות, פרטיות או עסקיות שאינן כלולות בסעיפים 6.12 עד 6.14. מטרות עסקיות כמו מבחן נהיגה מטעם משרד הרישוי והדרכת נהיגה (למעט שיעור נהיגה מתקדם) דורשות ציון מפורש בתעודת הביטוח. גם הובלת נוסעים בתשלום או גרירת רכב בתשלום מחייבות ציון מפורש בתעודת הביטוח. הפוליסה רלוונטית לשימוש ברכב לצורך מבחן נהיגה, הדרכת נהיגה, הובלת נוסעים בתשלום וגרירת רכב בתשלום.
notable_values: social, private or business objectives: not included in 6.12-6.14
driving test: requires notation on insurance certificate
teaching driving: requires notation on insurance certificate
passenger transport for payment: requires notation on insurance certificate
salvage/towing for payment: requires notation on insurance certificate

6.1.1 Social, private or business objectives of the insured, which are not included in paragraphs 6.12 through 6.14 hereunder.
6.1.2 A business objective - a driving test on behalf of the licensing authority and a business objective of teaching driving, which is not an advanced practical driving lesson in accordance with the Regulation 213a of the Transportation Regulations, provided that these objectives are expressly noted on the insurance certificate.
6.1.3 A business objective of transporting passengers in the vehicle for payment, a fee or other consideration, provided that the objective is expressly noted on the insurance certificate.
6.1.4 A business objective of salvage or towing of a motorized vehicle for payment, a fee or other consideration, provided that the objective is expressly noted on the insurance certificate.

This table details the permitted uses of the insured vehicle under the policy. It specifies objectives for which the insurance coverage applies, contingent on being noted on the insurance certificate where required.

6.1.1 Social, private or business objectives of the insured, which are not included in paragraphs 6.12 through 6.14 hereunder.
6.1.2 A business objective - a driving test on behalf of the licensing authority and a business objective of teaching driving, which is not an advanced practical driving lesson in accordance with the Regulation 213a of the Transportation Regulations, provided that these objectives are expressly noted on the insurance certificate.
6.1.3 A business objective of transporting passengers in the vehicle for payment, a fee or other consideration, provided that the objective is expressly noted on the insurance certificate.
6.1.4 A business objective of salvage or towing of a motorized vehicle for payment, a fee or other consideration, provided that the objective is expressly noted on the insurance certificate.
